1. Circular spots with a brown center ("pupil")
2. Yellow halo surrounding each lesion (the "eye" pattern)
3. Small to medium lesion size, scattered on otherwise green leaves
4. The leaf morphology is consistent with coffee (*Coffea* sp.)
